# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

She has light curly hair and captivating eyes. She wears beautiful attire featuring prominently puffed sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

She is an intelligent and compassionate woman who captures and maintains the affection of her pupils. Tactful, attentive, and open-minded, she encourages students to think independently and explore beyond traditional methods. She maintains absolute discipline through understanding and respect rather than physical punishment.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne was hired by the school trustees of Brierley as the village's first female schoolteacher. During her tenure, she introduced novel educational activities such as bi-weekly recitation afternoons, field trips to the forest for nature studies, morning and afternoon physical culture routines, and strict emphasis on clear writing and simple vocabulary. She also instituted an after-school class for proficient students preparing for the Regent's entrance examination. Though her departures from standard teaching practices drew skepticism from traditionalists like Mrs. Sowerby and the trustees, she won the deep affection of her students and maintained strict discipline without ever striking anyone. At the end of the school term, her tenure in Brierley concluded after she accepted a job offer in her home district's grade school. She later visited Brierley as a guest, attending a meal alongside the Waces, Nell, and Isolde.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v1 c31 P23](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0023), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 c17 P55](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0055)_
